description: This file contains the main entry point for a Java-based server application using Jetty. It sets up and starts an embedded Jetty server, configures web application context, and includes shutdown handling.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class configuring and running an embedded Jetty server, hosting a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes and starts the Jetty server, configures web context, and adds shutdown hook.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a resource in the classpath and returns it as a String.

methods.name: getResourceFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves the filesystem path of a resource in the classpath, suitable for Jetty resource configuration.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines the server port, using system property 'port' if available, or defaulting to 8090.
